tools.name: UniRig
tools.description: SIGGRAPH 2025 autoregressive transformer for skeleton tree prediction from mesh. MIT licensed.

tools.name: SkinTokens / TokenRig
tools.description: Skinning model: generates skin weights for existing skeleton. C++ port available.

tools.name: MKA (mka_v3)
tools.description: Universal pipeline bundling UniRig + SkinTokens. Apache-2.0.

tools.name: Pinocchio (Baran & Popovic)
tools.description: Classic SIGGRAPH 2007 automatic rigging. LGPL core = quarantine per rules (evaluate only, don't integrate).

tools.name: Blender 4.0.2 (installed)
tools.license: GPL (tool use is fine, outputs are ours)
tools.category: auto-rigging via automatic weights + Data Transfer
tools.description: Already installed at /usr/bin/blender. Armature Deform With Automatic Weights + Data Transfer modifier for weight copy between topologies.
tools.notes: blender_autorig.py: Mixamo-compatible armature via anatomical proportions + automatic weights. Tested on MARKS, visually verified.

tools.name: Mixamo auto-rigger
tools.license: Adobe ToS (free, commercial use allowed when embedded)
tools.description: Already in Forge3D catalog. Requires upload via web. Good quality humanoid rigs.

tools.name: AccuRIG (Reallusion)
tools.description: Already in Forge3D catalog. Free auto-rigger.

tools.name: DV Skin Tools
tools.description: Free Blender addon, Maya-style multi-influence weight painting. Requires Blender 4.2+ (we have 4.0.2 - may need check).

tools.name: Voxel Heat Diffuse Skinning
tools.description: Voxel-based automatic skinning for Blender, better than default automatic weights.

tools.name: Anymate
tools.description: Three-stage neural rigging: joint prediction, connectivity, neural skin weights. Apache-2.0.

tools.name: Make-It-Animatable
tools.license: AMBIGUOUS - Apache-2.0 on GitHub vs CC-BY-NC-4.0 on HF
tools.description: Targets Mixamo skeleton directly. License conflict must be resolved before use.

tools.name: skin-tokens.cpp CLI
tools.description: TokenRig: skeleton + skin weights as autoregressive sequence. CPU/Vulkan, minutes per mesh. Has 'skin' command for existing skeletons.

tools.name: rig-anything (Blender plugin)
tools.description: Measures, classifies, builds skeleton, binds, generates gait for arbitrary meshes.

tools.name: Surface-Heat-Diffuse-Skinning
tools.description: Voxel-grid heat diffusion skinning. Handles multi-piece characters better than Blender built-in. Pulled into tools/rig-tools/surface-heat/.

tools.name: BVH-Motion-Retargeter
tools.description: Blender addon for retargeting BVH mocap to Mixamo/UE5/VRM. Requires Blender 4.2+ (we have 4.0.2 - version mismatch).

tools.name: Cascadeur (free edition)
tools.license: Proprietary - NOT licensed for commercial use, .casc-only export
tools.description: Free edition is non-commercial and can't export to other DCC apps. REJECTED per license rules.
